title: Pretty disappointed actually
text: Pretty disappointed actually. I have bought these pillows in the past.  The last time I bought one in 2016, I unfortunately left it in the hotel so I had to purchase another one.  The pillow I received this time is much firmer than the last, not as heavy and I am not impressed.  Pretty disappointed actually.
